prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A 68-year-old man stands with his 66-year-old wife and their 38-year-old adult daughter at a small home anniversary gathering. His daughter rests a hand on his shoulder as the three laugh at a shared memory. Use a candid three-person portrait, late-afternoon window light, understated festive clothes, and a lived-in apartment background. Output a vertical 4:5 composition for a website cover. Keep the lower 20 percent visually quiet for an optional website caption; place no faces, hands, or key gestures there. Preserve generous space above and beside the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Additional subject and framing requirements: The father has thinning short grey hair, a clean-shaven rectangular face and brown eyes. His wife has short naturally silver curls, a round face and no glasses. Their adult daughter has long dark-blonde straight hair, a narrow face, and simple glasses. They are three visibly distinct ordinary relatives. Exact vertical 4:5; waist-up composition with quiet lower 20 percent.
review: Reviewed portrait: clean-shaven grey-haired father laughing between silver-curly-haired wife and long-dark-blonde-haired adult daughter with glasses. Daughter hand on shoulder is plausible, faces distinct and naturally aged; soft home window light, lower clothing and table area quiet, no text.
